Shortcuts and gestures

File

KeysEffect
Ctrl Oopen

Ctrl Pprint

Editing

KeysEffect
Ctrl Z; Ctrl Y, Ctrl Shift Zundo; redo
Ctrl C, Ctrl X, Ctrl Vcopy, cut, paste
Ctrl D; Ctrl Rfill down; right
Delete, ⌫empty the cells

Formatting

KeysEffect
Ctrl B, Ctrl I, Ctrl Ubold, italic, underlined

Moving, selecting

KeysEffect
arrow keysneighboring cell
Tab, Shift Tabnext, previous cell

Ctrl and clickadd to the selection

Entry

KeysEffect
F2, Enter, double clickedit the cell
Enterconfirm, move down

click or drag on the sheetinsert a reference in the formula

GestureEffect
drag the blue handlefill
